title.en: Why the same energy services could need far less input
title.zh: 同样的能源服务，为何可能少用许多能源输入

summary.en: A new modelling paper holds 2022 useful energy fixed and estimates much lower losses in an electrified system, while leaving deployment and future demand unresolved.
summary.zh: 新模型固定2022年的有用能源服务，估算电气化系统可大幅减少损耗；建设路径及未来需求仍是开放问题。

title.en: The robot that keeps a deep-sea world alive on its journey to the lab
title.zh: 把深海世界带进实验室：机器人如何守住生命的环境

summary.en: A new Manchester report explains a September study linking pressure-preserving sampling and robotic culture; living isolates offer a research advance with applications still open.
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特的新报道解读九月研究：保压采样与机器人培养相连，活体分离成果打开研究可能，应用仍待验证。
